response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10
